profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is the Oregon State Data Center in Salem, the state capital, operated by Enterprise Information Services, the state central IT agency, under its Data Center Services program, providing centralized data center hosting for Oregon state agencies. reading: The State of Oregon operates its enterprise government data center through Enterprise Information Services, the state's central IT agency, under a program called Data Center Services. The Oregon State Data Center facility linked to this operator record is located in Salem, the state capital, consistent with the agency's own published description of providing centralized data center hosting for Oregon state agencies. This state owned and operated facility is unrelated to a separate, much larger private data center campus proposed for the Salem area by a company called Verrus, a 5.1 billion dollar project for which Oregon's governor directed the withdrawal of state owned land in 2026 amid public opposition. That Verrus project is a commercial, privately financed development and has no connection to the state government's own internal IT data center covered by this operator record. No detailed capacity or megawattage figures for the Oregon State Data Center were published on the state's own site as of this research, so those fields are left unspecified rather than estimated. This record should not be merged or conflated with any future operator record created for the Verrus project, which represents a distinct commercial entity and facility.
